description: A bearded man in a bronze helmet and a blue-and-gold patterned robe sits in a wooden chair, one hand resting on an unrolled scroll marked with rows of wedge-like symbols and the other holding a large iron key. Behind him is a stone block wall with a lion relief, and shadowy bearded attendants stand at the edges, one holding a tall staff. It is a dark oil painting that fills the image edge to edge, with a small sparkle logo cropped in the lower right corner; no border, frame or easel.
